opening.argument: The webinar directs viewers to register for paid education packages involving token selling or mining, including a €5,000 tier providing 60,000 tokens with a claimed €9,000 token value. It presents the opportunity as essentially risk-free and claims €24,000 could become €240,000 within 12 months. Viewers are urged to upgrade quickly, sponsor people and build teams, with substantial gains linked to recruitment and repeated participation. One slide does qualify the €50–€100 price paths as predictions that may not be reached. That qualification does not resolve the presentation’s simultaneous use of risk-elimination language. The combination of paid mining access, exceptional return claims and recruitment-driven gains establishes the scam character of the offer.
